u.n: Contract Violation and Implicit Deny Bursts
u.v: Sudden increases in implicit denies or contract violations usually mean a mis-deployed contract, a missing EPG binding, or an attack probing disallowed paths. Catching bursts early prevents application outages and avoids silent security gaps where traffic is dropped without operator visibility.

index=cisco_aci (sourcetype="cisco:aci:contracts" OR sourcetype="cisco:aci:syslog") earliest=-4h
| bin _time span=5m
| eval denies=coalesce(deny_count, implicit_deny_count, 0)
| stats sum(denies) as deny_burst by _time, src_epg, dst_epg, contract_name
| eventstats median(deny_burst) as med by src_epg, dst_epg
| where deny_burst > med*10 AND deny_burst > 100
| sort -deny_burst
| table _time, src_epg, dst_epg, contract_name, deny_burst, med
u.m: (1) Normalize deny counters from contract stats or syslog patterns (`implicitDeny`, `vzBrCP`). (2) Tune multiplier and floor to fabric size. (3) Page on critical EPG pairs; attach last successful change ticket from audit (UC-18.1.5).
